title.zh: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz toll booth ran through a bitcoin exchange, U.S. says
title.en: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz toll booth ran through a bitcoin exchange, U.S. says

current_state.zh: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Tehran-based crypto exchange BitBank and its developer, alleging it moved hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to Iran's Revolutionary Guards and processed fees for ships paying for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
current_state.en: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Tehran-based crypto exchange BitBank and its developer, alleging it moved hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to Iran's Revolutionary Guards and processed fees for ships paying for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
